meta.audience: Coaches who have never sold an online course and are worried about launching to a small email list

title: The Pre-Launch Checklist for Your First Online Course
subtitle: Use it in the 2 weeks before you open the doors.

sections.heading: Your Offer
sections.goal: The reader will have a clear, sellable course offer.

items: Write your course promise in one sentence
List the 3 problems your course solves
Set your launch price and an end date for it
Outline every module on a single page

sections.heading: Your Sales Page
sections.goal: The reader will have a sales page ready to take payments.

items: Put your promise in the page headline
Add one section per module with its outcome
Answer the 5 questions buyers ask you most
Make a test purchase before launch day

sections.heading: Launch Week
sections.goal: The reader will have a simple email plan for launch week.

cta.heading: Want Help With Your Launch?
cta.text: Book a free 20-minute call and we will map out your launch week together.
